battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Map the entities representing your hybrid inverter's battery.

data.reserve_soc_sensor: Reserve SoC floor sensor (optional; reads the live minimum-SoC entity, e.g. GivEnergy battery_soc_reserve)

tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: Off-peak rate signals from your tariff provider integration.

data.off_peak_sensor: Off-peak rate sensor (whole house; active during overnight off-peak window and intra-day dispatch slots)
data.dispatching_sensor: Smart dispatch active (optional; e.g. Octopus Intelligent)

forecast_source.title: Solar forecast — source
forecast_source.description: Pick the kind of solar forecast available in Home Assistant.

data.forecast_solcast_sensor: Solcast forecast sensor (use the 'Forecast Tomorrow' sensor for overnight planning)
data.solar_generation_sensor: Actual generation sensor (optional; enables stats-based fallback)

loads.title: Loads & learning
loads.description: Optional inputs for baseline-load and daily-target learning.

data.home_load_sensor: Home load power sensor (optional; learns the calculated baseline)
data.managed_load_sensors: Managed loads to exclude from baseline (EV, hot-water diverter, …)
data.daily_energy_sensor: House energy sensor (optional; learns the daily kWh target from recorder history)
data.daily_kwh_target: Daily kWh target (fallback constant when not learned)

ev.title: EV charger (optional)
ev.description: Optional EV charger inputs — surfaced on the dashboard and reserved for upcoming EV-aware planning. They no longer affect the discharge guard (the off-peak signal already covers EV charging).

hotwater.title: Hot water (optional)
hotwater.description: Track a solar diverter (myenergi Eddi) and prompt for a manual boost before a cloudy spell leaves the tank cold. Inert unless the green + status sensors are set.

data.hotwater_green_sensor: Green/diverted energy sensor (kWh, total_increasing) — core energy-in
data.hotwater_status_sensor: Diverter status sensor (emits 'Max temp reached' when the tank is full)
data.hotwater_heater_kw: Heater power (kW) — sets the suggested boost duration
data.hotwater_threshold_percent: Reserve threshold (%) — prompt when projected below this
data.hotwater_depletion_kwh: Daily depletion fallback (kWh/day) — used until learned
data.hotwater_max_temp_state: Status value meaning 'tank full' (default 'Max temp reached')

grid.title: Grid meter & verification (optional)
grid.description: Read-only meter input for observability and an actuation sanity-check. Set the two grid power sensors (import + export, always-positive) and/or the battery power sensor; EC then checks that a discharge cap actually idled the battery and raises a problem if not. No effect on planning.

data.grid_import_sensor: Grid import power sensor (W, always positive)
data.grid_export_sensor: Grid export power sensor (W, always positive)
data.battery_power_positive_is_charging: Battery power: positive means charging (leave off if positive = discharging)

costs.title: Costs & payback (optional)
costs.description: Feeds the ledger and the modelled money sensors. Billing-grade entities (e.g. Octopus accumulative cost and standing-charge sensors) are read directly; each modelled sensor is created only when its own sources are set. Everything here is optional.

data.import_cost_off_peak_sensor: Import cost today — off-peak share (optional split)
data.import_cost_peak_sensor: Import cost today — peak share (optional split)
data.system_capital_cost_gbp: System capital cost (GBP) — enables the payback tracker
data.public_charging_rate_gbp_per_kwh: Public-charging comparator rate (GBP/kWh; blank hides the comparison)

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: Write mode, notification target and planning schedule.

data.device_name: Site name (appended to 'Energy Conductor', e.g. 'Blithe' → 'Energy Conductor Blithe')
